story.subtitle: 01 / Foundation
story.title: Listening to the Seasons
story.paragraph1: Tanah Kitchen & Bar was founded upon a singular realization: that contemporary dining has lost its connection with local soil cycles. Our journey began not in industrial kitchens, but in local small-scale crop trials where we cultivated indigenous millets and ancient grains.
story.paragraph2: We design menus around direct agrarian partnerships. Every morning, fresh root vegetables, hand-pressed oils, and farm herbs are delivered directly from organic cooperative fields in Gachibowli's agricultural greenbelts.

philosophy.subtitle: Our Philosophy
philosophy.title: Nurtured by Soil,
philosophy.paragraph1: At Tanah, our name translates to "Earth". We view dining not merely as a menu to be ordered, but as a complete spatial and sensory choreography. The organic curves of our wood-fired hearth and the raw basalt stone tables reflect our architectural heritage.
philosophy.paragraph2: By working in tandem with the seasonal soil cycles of Gachibowli's organic network, we receive raw heirloom crops and wood-fire them on open coals. No chemical enhancers, no industrial scale — just raw fire, clay pots, and mindful preservation.

quoteSection.subtitle: Stewardship
quoteSection.quote: We treat agricultural harvesting as curated exhibitions. The goal is to let the raw ingredients express their heritage, fire-grilled simply on coals and seasoned with natural sea salt.
quoteSection.author: Culinary Directors, Tanah

sustainability.title: Sustainability & Circularity
sustainability.paragraph: We design our rooftop kitchen to be completely zero-waste, feeding organic compost back into Gachibowli greenbelt soils.

items.title: Zero Food Waste
items.desc: Every vegetable scrap is fermented into premium broth, pickled, or composted back into agricultural soil.

items.title: Plastic-Free Sourcing
items.desc: All kitchen ingredients are received in woven jute sacks, brass canisters, or reusable terracotta crates.

items.title: Solar Powered Cooking
items.desc: Our tandoors and wood ovens operate in balance with green solar power grids to heat water and run machines.

team.name: Chef Harish Chandra
team.desc: 20+ years of wood-fired gastronomy, specialized in ancient claypot slow cooking and seed selection.

team.name: Devika Nair
team.desc: Directs our cooperative farm networks, establishing regenerative agricultural soil cycles.

timeline.title: The First Seed
timeline.desc: Began cultivation trials on small organic plots using native heirloom crop grains.

timeline.title: Tanah Cooperative
